newsitem.title: USA: Wilmington Trust deliverable silver 59.4 mln ounce.
newsitem.headline: Wilmington Trust deliverable silver 59.4 mln ounce.

text.p: The COMEX division of New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) told traders early Tuesday that Wilmington Trust had 59.4 million ounces of silver in deliverable form on Sept 30, according to traders.
Wilmington Trust of Delaware becomes an official exchange silver depositary from Jan 1, 1997.

The total silver stocks held by Wilmington Trust may be higher than 59.4 million though, analysts said, and more of the stocks held by Wilmington may be converted to a form deliverable under COMEX silver futures contract specifications before Jan 1.
